name: Silvio Ricci
source:
The first prince of Benitoite, an allied kingdom. He behaves arrogantly and flamboyantly, subdues everything with money and violence, and is easily overwhelmed. It's because he has everything that he seems to act arrogant.

"What, isn't it just a matter of changing weapons from swords to gold?"

[Translated from in-game profile]
